title: The Last Aftermath
author: Casper Sterling
blurb: August Coldharbour, a former prodigy returning to the conservatory as a janitor, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. But when the last speaker of a language asks for one final student, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
